note: New-user rescue wave: empty-library asks (packs on discord + reddit streaming), pack install celebration, and the three once-ever firsts. Moment specs for the integrator are in the moments block; ids are assigned at integration.

noMediaYet.ctx: none; fired when the library is empty and MediaSource is local

noMediaYet.t: your folders are empty. i checked twice. we can fix that.
no pics in the drawer yet. i know where people get them.
the shelf's bare. happens to everyone on day one.
nothing to flash yet. the discord has packs for days.
empty library. big dreams. i respect it.
i looked for your stash. there isn't one. yet.
no media, no problem. i can pull from reddit. say when.
packs exist. people share them daily. i keep the map.
your assets folder echoes. i yelled in it. nothing.
the folder's still emtpy. i peek sometimes. sue me.

contentPackInstalled.t: pack's in. shelves full. i already peeked.
new pack installed. smells like fresh pixels.
{target} is in. good pick. i would've picked it.
unpacked and shelved. i did the heavy lifting. one file.
loot acquired. that's the fun kind of install.
your library grew. i watered it.
that's a lot of new stuff. flash night?
pack instaled. counted everything. its all there.

firstFlashEver.t: first flash. there it was. there it went.
you saw that too right. ok good. more where that came from.
that was your first one. i clapped. quietly.
one down. the rest are already lining up.
blink and you miss it. you didn't. proud of you.
so thats a flash. you get used to them. mostly.

firstVideoEver.t: first video. i'll be quiet. i'll try.
your first one. sit comfy. eyes forward.
i've seen this part. no spoilers. watch.
big screen energy. tiny me energy. balance.
the room goes soft around these. you'll see.

firstSessionEver.t: your first session. i'll hold the desk. go under. i mean in.
first run. the timer's mine. you just be there.
oh!! a real session. ok. i've read about these.
i set a bookmark. it says you started today.
session one. of many. i said what i said.
deep breath. it's just time with the app. and me.

yes.t: sending you. people drop new ones daily. take two.

no.t: ok. the pile keeps growing tho. just saying.

yes.t: the discord has a whole pack shelf. go shopping.

no.t: later's fine. the shelf isn't going anywhere.

asks.q: want me to fetch from reddit?

yes.t: on it. pick your niches and i do the rest.

no.t: ok. offer stands. i'm very patient.

asks.q: i can stream media. try it?

yes.t: assets tab. top panel. i left it open for you.

no.t: nah is fine. your app, your shelves.
